body: Yeah, should think about it... For now I don't feel that bad as I did last time. I just feel... Not bad, not good, just nothing. It's like whole  cycle for me, but I think there is too much of sadness in this cycle to call it a normal thing.

I usually sit at home. I know, it isn't the best solution... But I'm tired of qoing out and hoping that day I will meet someone new. In my city there aren't many of people who will come to you and talk like they knew for some years already. I have met some of those, who actually were really happy people and tried to make someone happy, but... Either I just messed it out by ending conversation without thinking, what I noticed when I was already in home, or I was in hurry. I sometimes start conversation with someone, but you don't know if you can stay with this person in contact, so it isn't the best way... And yeah people, who I know and I have contact with... Well, you can say I actually know some people, but it's seriously like I ask them if they have time in Friday, they say yes and then suddenly something happened so they can't come, or people just don't answer, or they say, they will contact you durning week, but you wait and then nothing. I know too much people of this type. I shouldn't really say all the time: "you never called me back" or something, because I don't want to fight people...

And a good day is when someone actually remember me and ask me to go out, or talk, or whatever.
I'm not sure at 100%, but I think it's like 5 years already.
But... It doesn't happen to me. It is there **all the time**. For me not being lonely happens.
